name: What types of lever door handles are available?

mainEntity.name: What types of lever door handles are available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lever door handles come in several functional types to suit different needs. 'Passage' levers have no lock and are used for hallways or closets. 'Privacy' levers include a push-button or turn-button lock, suitable for bedrooms and bathrooms. 'Keyed Entry' levers offer a key-operated lock on the exterior and a turn-button on the interior, ideal for exterior doors or rooms needing higher security. 'Dummy' levers are non-functional, used for decorative purposes on inactive doors. Each type is available in various finishes and designs to complement your home's decor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Types include passage (no lock), privacy (push-button lock), keyed entry (key-operated), and dummy (non-functional/decorative) levers.
